This type of '''tank''' was used by the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Several such tanks were deployed at the [[Battle of unidentified planet (Yoda's chaingun)|battle of unidentified planet]] where they were destroyed by [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]].
